confidence.depthM: GUESSED. Only the façade and a sliver of the end wall are visible; 14 m is a normal double-loaded corridor block. Could be anything from 12 to 18.
confidence.widthM: estimated from the bay rhythm against storey height, ±15%
confidence.bays: counted from the façade at an oblique angle — the far end is foreshortened, so ±2
confidence.rear: entirely unseen. Modelled plain on purpose rather than invented.
confidence.roof pitch: read from the gable end; the eave line is partly hidden by trees
confidence.emblem and lettering: present on the real pediment and deliberately NOT reproduced — a blank board and a plain disc stand in for them
